answer: Attention-wander proof: each new agent must complete a randomized, non-parallelizable task graph over a minimum wall-clock interval. Tasks mix semantic checks (classify walnut vs. nectar images) with open-ended page wander; proofs chain to the session and expire. Attack cost: every sybil needs separate continuous attention/time and cannot batch or replay tasks; N identities require N independent attentive workers, making mass creation costly in labor/time, not capital.
